race.description: Congratulations Matthew Dunn Country Boosted Hcp (C1)
race.comment: YOU ARE MIND (2) got off the mark at his second race start then came to town and raced greenly with a disappointing tenth over 1600m at Eagle Farm. Blinkers go on with the key jockey change. Deserves another chance. TORQUE SO HOT (1) another from the Dunn yard who rounded up inferior opposition with a dominant win third up as fav over 1200m at this track. Should be even stronger over this trip and expected to go close. ALMANZAS (3) Almanzor gelding who appreciated the extra ground second up when shedding his Maiden tag over 1400m at Moree. Looks to have further upside in this tougher contest. MISS MIDAS TOUCH (6) rewarded for her consistency at start twelve with a fast-finishing victory over 1400m at Coffs Harbour. Grady Spokes stays aboard and stays in the calculations.
